verdict: Driver injection into the offline image failed during OS deployment. DISM rejected `/Add-Driver` with `ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED`, typically because the driver architecture or INF target build does not match the WIM.

evidence.match: Failed to add driver to driver store

fix: In `smsts.log`, locate the `Apply Driver Package` step and identify the specific INF that failed. Confirm architecture matches the WIM (x64 drivers only on x64 images). Remove drivers whose INF target decorators reference older OS versions (`NT amd64.6.3` on Win10/11 targets). Repackage the driver pack excluding incompatible entries. If the failure only happens on certain models, pin the driver package to a model-specific task sequence via a Query WMI condition.
